name: procedure
title: Controlled procedure snapshot
for_each: select p.id,p.reference as name from processes p join current_procedures c on c.process_id=p.id where p.status='active'

sections.title: Control record
sections.sql: select p.reference,p.name,p.owner,p.review_due,c.version,c.objective,c.approver,c.approved_at,c.evidence_ref,c.safety_review_ref from processes p join current_procedures c on c.process_id=p.id where p.id=$1
sections.note: Internal snapshot. Verify the current version before use. Evidence references are operator supplied.

sections.title: Procedure steps
sections.sql: select s.ordinality as step,s.value->>'title' as instruction,s.value->>'role' as responsible_role,s.value->>'active_minutes' as active_minutes,s.value->>'wait_minutes' as wait_minutes from current_procedures c cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(c.steps) with ordinality s(value,ordinality) where c.process_id=$1 order by s.ordinality

name: review-brief
title: Process owner review brief
for_each: select id,reference as name from processes where status<>'archived'

sections.title: Improvement actions
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due,priority from improvement_queue where process=(select reference from processes where id=$1)

sections.title: Checks needing assessment
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where process_id=$1

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select actor,note,evidence_ref,next_review,created_at from reviews where process_id=$1 order by created_at desc

name: change-record
title: Procedure change record
for_each: select id,reference as name from processes

sections.title: Revision history
sections.sql: select version,objective,change_reason,author,status,approver,approved_at,evidence_ref,safety_review_ref from revisions where process_id=$1 order by version

sections.title: Activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from activity where process_id=$1 order by created_at
